def factor_volume_return_dir_corr_rankvoldev(df):
    """Rolling correlation between daily return and time-series ranked volume deviation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_mean = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_dev_raw = df_copy["volume"] / vol_mean - 1.0
    vol_dev_rank = vol_dev_raw.rolling(30, min_periods=20).rank(pct=True)
    corr = daily_ret.rolling(30, min_periods=20).corr(vol_dev_rank)
    factor = corr.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_return_dir_corr_rankvoldev"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_return_dir_corr_rankvoldev"]
